change_note: NG_Modbus slow-link/LoRa hardening: (1) in-place BAD_TIMEOUT retry up to MIN(Device.retryCount, MaxTimeoutRetries=2) with late-frame draining; (2) small-gap register merging (MaxMergeGap=16, MaxGapSpan=40, SDM630 8->3 reads) with automatic Modbus Exception fallback; (3) configurable InterFrameGapMs + RTT-adaptive 150ms slow-link pacing (0ms on fast Ethernet).
